note: The superset of every rule enforced by eslint (2026-08-20 baseline) and oxlint (current .oxlintrc.json), including rules no rules block names. verify must enforce all of these. `enabledBy` says which surface turns a rule on: `rulesBlock` for a rule written down, `pluginDefault` for one contributed by an oxlint `plugins` declaration and invisible to any config read. `severity` is what the tool reports today, and it is recorded so that raising a warning to an error later is a config change rather than a porting project.
